the use of multiple delayed proportional gains can stabilize a triple zero bifurcated system.

the multiple delayed proportional gain controller is able to stabilize the inverted pendulum on the cart, even in presence of uncertainties, by means of a nonlinear analysis of a three dimensional system with a codimension three triple zero bifurcations, and by a stability analysis of the linear time invariant system.

we have proposed a control scheme for the stabilization of a multiple zero dynamics system using multiple delayed measurements instead than derivatives, we have performed a nonlinear and a linear stability analysis of the inverted pendulum system, and we have shown the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, by using a multiple delayed proportional gains control, we are able to stabilize an unstable system with an arbitrarily large delay.
the use of a single delayed term can be enough to stabilize the system, however, the use of two or more delayed terms improves the robustness of the closed loop system.

, in the case of an inverted pendulm on a cart, the use of multiple delayed proportional gains allows for a better control performance in terms of settling time and overshoot, with respect to the case of a single delayed proportional gain.
